info.title: dt-openapi: lint and compare OpenAPI documents against the Digitals rules.
info.description: Lints any OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 document against the Digitals API rules and diffs a design against its implementation. Bundles vacuum and oasdiff, so it needs nothing else installed.

commands.name: breaking
commands.description: Fail on a breaking change between two versions

commands.description: List the test cases the contract implies

commands.name: changelog
commands.description: List the changes between two versions

commands.description: Browse the findings in the terminal
